npc.trader.line: Fresh cards, new every day! And emeralds, if you've got diamonds to spare.
npc.card_master.line: Your deck: {count}/{max} slots. A good deck mixes cheap troops with a heavy hitter – you can craft your own card table from a chest and paper.
npc.researcher.line: Copies of a card plus emeralds – and I'll make it stronger. Ten percent per level.
npc.smith.line: Quicker locks or a lucky hammer? Costs diamonds, lasts forever.
npc.mayor.welcome: Welcome to your village, {player}. The monsters have treated us badly.
npc.mayor.ruins: {count} buildings still lie in ruins. Win battles, collect emeralds and rebuild them – Shift + right-click the sign in front of the ruin.
npc.mayor.rebuilt: Everything is standing again! You saved the village. Now it's time to collect roses and unite the clans.
npc.mayor.roses: Roses are our thanks – you get them for victories and lose them in defeats. They show how strong you are.
npc.chest_keeper.empty.1: Your treasure hall is empty. Every victory in the arena brings a chest – the rarer, the fuller.
npc.chest_keeper.empty.2: Opening takes time. Those who don't want to wait pay diamonds.
npc.chest_keeper.ready.one: {count} chest is ready! Right-click the chest – I guarded it like my own gold.
npc.chest_keeper.ready.many: {count} chests are ready! Right-click the chest – I guarded them like my own gold.
npc.chest_keeper.waiting.1: Your chests are working. Patience – or diamonds.
npc.chest_keeper.waiting.2: The smith in the town hall can make the locks faster.
npc.miner.ruin: Beneath the rubble lies a rich vein. Rebuild the mine ({cost} emeralds) and it will dig for you – even while you sleep.
npc.clan_warden.ruin: The clan hall lies in ruins. Build it ({cost} emeralds), then I'll lead you to the clans – and to the wars.
npc.clan_warden.line: Clans fight for glory and war chests. Here you manage your clan – and I'll take you to the battlefield.
npc.battle_master.1: Three towers, one goal: their primary tower falls, or you hold more towers than the enemy when time runs out.
npc.battle_master.2: Cards cost energy, and your energy charges up during battle. Only place on your half.
npc.battle_master.queue: I'll put you in the queue – Shift+right-click your sword if you change your mind.
npc.battle_master.no_queue: There is no queue on this server – /test match for a practice match.
npc.ambient.2: Have you seen the chests? Bodo won't let anyone near them.
npc.ambient.3: Alrik talks a lot – but he's right.
npc.ambient.5: Watch out for the Enderman card, it's sneaky.
